title: Streamline Terraform provider matrix for inter-region networking and reduce plan churn
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Our environment uses a scattershot set of Terraform provider versions and network templates across workspaces which causes frequent plan drift, unpredictable provider behavior (especially around EIP/NAT lifecycle), and blocked upgrades when attempting to move to AWS provider v5.x. This ticket consolidates and standardizes the provider matrix for inter-region VPC templates and eliminates common plan churn causes. Goals: 1) Introduce a single provider pinning module and provider alias strategy that works across multi-region stacks; 2) Upgrade aws provider to 5.x where safe and document breaking changes; 3) Remove legacy data source anti-patterns (count on data resources) and replace with explicit state moves or remote state references to prevent drift; 4) Add CI plan validation and drift detection checks to prevent regressions. Expected impact: reduce infra churn, unblock downstream upgrades, and improve rollout predictability for Dedicated & Private networking deployments.
acceptance_criteria: Provider pinning module merged and consumed by network blueprints
All regional network stacks successfully upgraded in non-prod with no destructive diffs
CI plan validation runs on PRs and prevents provider mismatches
Runbook for state moves and rollbacks published and reviewed
comments: 2025-02-12 - Kickoff: scoped initial provider module design. Identified two problem modules: vpc-blueprint and cross-region-peering. Aisha to produce design doc.
2025-02-18 - Design review: PM/ENG feedback to support aliasing per region rather than separate providers per account. Agreed to prefer provider_alias pattern to reduce interpolation complexity.

2025-02-24 - Prototype: Connor submitted POC that pins aws~>5.0 for non-prod and uses for_each on region map to create region providers. Prototype uncovered breaking change in aws_eip lifecycle behavior; we need a migration plan.

2025-02-26 - Migration plan: Decided to perform state moves for EIP resources and convert any count-based data lookups to explicit remote state outputs. Prepared step-by-step state mv runbook and a preflight checklist.
2025-03-01 - CI: Added terraform validate + plan check pipeline for infra repo. It now fails PRs with provider mismatch across changed modules.

2025-03-04 - Risk assessment: Scoped a canary sequence to upgrade two low-traffic regions first (eu-west-1, us-west-2). If canary shows plan drift > 5% or any destructive action flagged, we will rollback and open a follow-up ticket to address the specific resource types.
Reviewer note (Sofia Martinez): Please add explicit test fixtures for EIP allocation + NAT gateway scenarios. Also add notes about provider SDK changes in the design doc.
2025-03-04 - Connor: opened PR #7890 implementing provider-pinning module and updated vpc-blueprint to consume it. Requesting review from infra-sig and tagging owners for state migration window.
